cards.title: Distinction Between Per-MIC PTA and MIC-Weighted CFR
cards.claim: Per-MIC PTA requires a defined MIC grid and PK/PD target but does not require an observed MIC distribution. MIC-weighted CFR requires a specific organism population, MIC bins, frequencies, and denominator. These are distinct tasks with different input requirements.
conditions: Per-MIC PTA is a conditional probability given an MIC.
Do not infer a population distribution from a single MIC point.
required_inputs: For PTA: MIC value/grid, PK model, PD target.
For CFR: MIC distribution (bins, counts, denominator), PTA at each bin.
limitations: CFR is invalid if the MIC distribution is not representative of the target population.
Open-ended bins or omitted isolates must be handled explicitly.
cards.downstream_use: Separate reporting of susceptibility-specific efficacy vs. population-level coverage.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
